readerJob: Decide whether a Netherlands-based creator should pay for the 14-inch MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR and M5 Pro for its touch tandem-OLED display, port set and pro workflow ceiling, or choose the lower-priced 14-inch M6 model or retain an existing system.
decision: Do not issue a buying recommendation yet. Apple establishes an orderable Dutch 14-inch M5 Pro configuration and a material price premium over the new 14-inch M6 family, but manufacturer specifications and demonstrations do not establish sustained creator performance, touch-workflow value, display accuracy after field use, thermal behaviour, battery endurance or whether this exact configuration is better than the reader's current system.
wrongPurchaseConditions: The buyer expects Touch alone to improve Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, Pixelmator Pro or another workflow without testing the exact application version and input method.
The buyer does not need the PROLED display, Thunderbolt 5, SDXC slot or multi-display ceiling and can meet the workload with the lower-priced 14-inch M6 model.
The buyer needs more than 24 GB unified memory or 1 TB storage and assumes the observed base configuration is upgradeable after purchase.

The buyer treats Apple's family-level 'up to 24 hours' language as the exact 14-inch M5 Pro result; Apple's detailed specification states up to 22 hours of video streaming and 14 hours of wireless web.
The buyer needs independently verified sustained rendering, local-model, noise or thermal performance rather than manufacturer positioning.
The buyer's essential tools, peripherals or collaboration environment require Windows, CUDA or another platform-specific capability.
The buyer cannot justify the dated EUR 1,020 starting-price difference versus the 14-inch M6 family without a named workflow that uses the premium hardware.
evidenceLevel: official Apple Netherlands launch, product, store and global specification evidence; no hands-on testing
